notes: The Item 7 (targeted) section contained no text, so all scoring rests on Item 1. 'Licensing', 'collaboration' and 'partner' language throughout refers to drug and patent deals (traps) and was not counted. The 10-K points to www.ligand.com for ESG policies but also describes specific activities itself, so coverage is not insufficient. 'Diversity and inclusion initiatives' is named without any described practice, so it is treated as a label (max 1). The $2.6 million solar investment in the quoted EHS sentence is environmental, not a community or education figure, so it is not used as an indicator for the donations. Past spin-offs (OmniAb, Pelican, Pelthos carve-out) are not relevant to any theme. Workforce is small (47 full-time employees).
